Edit the plugin's project in the registry

Usage: hpy registry plugin edit [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json                         Print the result as JSON on stdout
      --name <NAME>                  Project name (default: hpy.toml [project] name, then
                                     manifest.json id)
      --display-name <DISPLAY_NAME>  The name people see (the publication's name)
      --no-input                     Never prompt; fail when a value is missing. Irreversible
                                     actions still need --yes. Implied without a terminal
  -C <DIR>                           Run as if started in DIR
      --description <DESCRIPTION>    One-line description
      --author <AUTHOR>              Author as `Name <email> (url)`; repeatable
      --security <CONTACT>           Security contact (email or URL); repeatable
      --keyword <KEYWORD>            Keyword; repeatable
      --remove-keyword <KEYWORD>     Remove a keyword; repeatable
  -h, --help                         Print help
